subject: Re: BrightLayer - model mix & pricing qualification
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Subject: BrightLayer — post-call recap & next steps (model mix + volumes)

Hi Jake / Elena,

Thanks for the call earlier — quick recap and a few asks so we can put together an accurate estimate for hosted vs dedicated: 

Summary from call:
- Primary use: in-product chat assistant (customer support + proactive suggestions)
- Secondary: embeddings for semantic search and reranking on knowledge base articles
- Timeline: pilot in Q4, GA in Q1 next year

Can you confirm the following so we can size capacity and unit economics?
1) Expected monthly token volumes by model type (rough ballpark is fine): chat (prompt+response), embeddings (requests/day + avg token per request), rerank (requests/day or per-query tokens)
2) Target budget range / monthly spend you’re comfortable with for the pilot and GA (helps us recommend hosted vs reserved capacity)
3) Any hard perf/SLA needs (p95 latency targets) or security constraints beyond SOC2 that we should account for

Next steps: if you send the volumes and budget range I’ll loop in Vivek and Neha and we’ll send an estimate + recommended model mix/quantization options and a draft mutual action plan by Tue.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Jake Miller <jake@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena@brightlayer.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLayer — post-call recap & next steps (model mix + volumes)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the follow-up. Below are the numbers we discussed (these are estimates from our product team):

Volumes (expected, monthly):
- Chat (primary): ~250M tokens/month (this is combined prompt + response; peak concurrency around 40 qps)
- Embeddings: ~120k requests/day (~3.6M requests/month). Average embedding size ~512 tokens/request (indexing + runtime queries) => ~1.84B tokens/month (NOTE: embeddings are batched differently from chat)
- Rerank: ~30k requests/day, average 250 tokens/request => ~7.5M tokens/month

Model mix (by token volume):
- Chat models (chat generations): ~10% of total token volume but highest latency sensitivity
- Embeddings: ~88% of total token volume (large due to indexing churn + queries)
- Rerank: ~2%

Budget: For pilot we have roughly $30k–$45k/month budgeted. For GA we can expand but want to validate unit economics first. Our procurement/security folks will need an initial SOW + invoice cadence; we can share contacts once we have a baseline estimate.

Happy to jump on a quick follow-up to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Jake Miller
Director of Product | BrightLayer
jake@brightlayer.com

Thanks Jake — super helpful. A couple clarifying Qs so our cost model aligns with your expectations:

- When you say embeddings ~512 tokens/request, is that for the vectors you store (indexing) or average runtime query? If both, can you split indexing vs query?
- For chat: is the 250M tokens/month mostly user prompts (short) + assistant responses (long), or evenly split? Any expected average conversation length / context window?
- Do you have a target $/1M tokens (ballpark) you consider acceptable for GA? You noted wanting to validate unit economics — if you can share a target it helps us optimize (e.g., suggest quantized model variants, batching, or Dedicated capacity).

Vivek / Neha — tagging you to confirm assumptions below and to produce a high-level hosted vs dedicated cost comparison + recommended model/quantization mix.

Proposed follow-up: 30 min tomorrow to review the draft estimate and tradeoffs. Jake, does Tue 11:00 AM PT work?

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Jake Miller <jake@brightlayer.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BrightLayer — post-call recap & next steps (model mix + volumes)

Hi Jake / team — quick technical/cost note and attached rough estimate (see Redwood_Estimate_BrightLayer_v1.pdf). Assumptions:

- Chat: avg combined prompt+response = 120 tokens/session, 250M tokens/month => ~2.08M chat requests/month. Hosted unit estimate (baseline gen model): ~$14 per 1M tokens.
- Embeddings: avg 512 tokens/request, 3.6M requests/month => ~1.84B tokens/month. Embedding unit estimate (higher-cost I/O and compute): ~$8 per 1M tokens when heavily batched for indexing; runtime queries (low-latency) priced higher effectively ~$20 per 1M tokens. For sizing we used blended embeddings effective $12 per 1M tokens.
- Rerank: small volume, use quantized CPU fallback for cheaper ops; estimate ~$6 per 1M tokens.

Blended example unit economics (rounded):
- Chat: $14 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (blended): $12 / 1M tokens
- Rerank: $6 / 1M tokens

Using Jake's volumes the monthly cost (hosted, before discounts or dedicated commitments):
- Chat: 250M tokens * $14/1M = $3,500/month
- Embeddings: 1.84B tokens * $12/1M = $22,080/month
- Rerank: 7.5M tokens * $6/1M = $45/month
- Total est: ~$25.6k/month (hosted, nominal) — aligns with the pilot budget range Jake mentioned.

Notes / recommendations:
- If BrightLayer can commit to a Dedicated capacity (3–6 month reserved), we can optimize embeddings indexing workflows (large batches during off-peak) and target blended costs closer to $7–9 / 1M tokens for embeddings, bringing total unit cost down ~25–40%.
- For GA, consider storing more precomputed embeddings and throttling indexing frequency to reduce indexing spikes. Also look at tokenization and shorter context windows for chat where latency is sensitive.

Attached: Redwood_Estimate_BrightLayer_v1.pdf (contains breakdown, assumptions, and two scenarios: Hosted vs Dedicated).

-Vivek
